locale.description: Language code of this file, used for <html lang> in the popup. Not a text to translate: it is the code of the locale folder.

extDescription.message: Highlights, collapses or hides sponsored content on Google, Amazon, eBay, Subito and other sites. YouTube ads at 16x.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the browser and in the store listing (max 132 characters).

popupCountMany.description: Popup, under the number: more than one sponsored item found (also 0).

popupCountOne.description: Popup, under the number: exactly one sponsored item found.

popupNoScan.description: Popup, in place of the counter label: the page could not be scanned.

popupNoScanHint.message: Page not supported, or reload it
popupNoScanHint.description: Popup, under "Not scanned": why, and what to do.

popupDetector.description: Popup, under the counter: the site detector in use, e.g. "Detector: Amazon".

popupGeneric.description: Popup: name of the generic detection (toggle title, and detector in use on other sites).

popupUnsupported.description: Popup, under the counter: no detector for this site and generic detection off.

popupModeTitle.description: Popup: title above the three mode buttons.

popupModeLabel.description: Popup: accessible name (aria-label) of the group of mode buttons.

popupModeHighlight.description: Popup: mode button, sponsored items get a border and a badge.

popupModeCollapse.description: Popup: mode button, sponsored items become a bar that opens on click.

popupModeHide.description: Popup: mode button, sponsored items disappear.

popupActiveOn.description: Popup: first part of the site toggle, followed by the site name in bold.

popupThisSite.description: Popup: stands in for the site name when there is none.

popupGenericHint.message: Looks for "Sponsored" labels on other sites too
popupGenericHint.description: Popup: hint under the generic detection toggle.

popupOffHere.message: Off on this site: items are counted but not changed.
popupOffHere.description: Popup, at the bottom: the extension is turned off on this site.

pageCollapsed.description: On the page: text of the bar that replaces a collapsed sponsored item.

pageAdBefore.description: On YouTube, over a video ad: text before the remaining time (e.g. "Ad ·" in "Ad · 0:12 left").

pageAdAfter.description: On YouTube, over a video ad: text after the remaining time (e.g. "left" in "Ad · 0:12 left"); may be empty.

popupReport.description: Popup, at the bottom: link that opens a new GitHub issue to report something that does not work.

reportTitle.description: Title of the GitHub issue opened by "Report a problem", e.g. "Problem on www.amazon.it".

reportTitleNoPage.description: Title of the GitHub issue opened by "Report a problem" when the page could not be scanned.

reportPrompt.description: First line of the GitHub issue opened by "Report a problem": the user writes the answer below it.
